purpose: capture aligned live and upstream-composed RMS-normalized MLP inputs for exact quadratic residual-drift attribution

worlds.live: all modules upstream of the target MLP execute the pinned native checkpoint
worlds.composed: the declared frozen upstream replacement prefix executes recursively on the same tokens

artifact_fields.observation_ids: int64 [observations,2] containing source-row index and token position

alignment_invariants: one observation ID per state row
observation IDs unique and lexicographically increasing
identical rows, token positions, checkpoint, and target interface across worlds
only the declared upstream program differs between worlds
capture is immutable before diagnostic aggregation
operational_semantics: diagnostic attribution only; does not populate held-out, composite, extraction, removal, or OOD lanes
